mapper.insert: INSERT INTO replay_calc_task (trade_date, calc_type, status, attempt) VALUES (#{tradeDate}, #{calcType}, 0, 0) ON CONFLICT (trade_date, calc_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE replay_calc_task SET status = 1, node = #{node}, attempt = attempt + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND calc_type = #{calcType} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, trade_date, calc_type, status, node, attempt, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM replay_calc_task WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY calc_type
